base: Use case: identity-preserve. Image1 ORIGINAL PHOTO is the authoritative identity reference for Adam. Image2 is EDIT TARGET, a nine-pose 3x3 game atlas. Correct the identity drift in EVERY character in image2. Replace the generic Pixar/Disney-like cartoon facial anatomy and toy curls with a faithful softly illustrated likeness of the actual boy in image1. Prioritize original face width/length, actual almond-shaped dark brown eyes with natural modest size (NOT huge round eyes), full eyebrows, actual nose bridge/tip and lips, natural cheek contours and chin, warm skin, recognisable smile. Hair is thick BLACK gently wavy hair with natural texture and original hairline, not sculpted shiny ringlets. FOUR YEARS OLD as supplied, not an older boy. Natural restrained semi-realistic 2D painted game illustration, not 3D animation, not chibi, not doll, not glossy plastic. Do not just recolor the cartoon face: restore the original child's distinctive facial features. Keep right-facing three-quarter heads and gaze toward travel, no eye contact with viewer; visible face enough to recognise original child. Preserve EXACT 3x3 cell layout, nine body poses, compact feet under pelvis, one raised fist above head on ascent/apex, body and head scale and positioning, blue jacket white shirt navy shorts blue shoes yellow backpack from image2. All nine heads must be the SAME original child at consistent scale, no hats. Preserve all limbs and cell boundaries, all figures full-body uncropped. Row-major sequence idle, takeoff, early rise, late rise, apex, descent, landing approach, contact, victory unchanged. Pure uniform #FF00FF magenta background, no shadows, no text/gridlines, high resolution clean detailed atlas. Original photo guides facial identity ONLY, do not include the photo or its background in output.

identity_master: Identity-preserving character correction. Input1 original portrait photograph is the authoritative actual child identity. Input2 is an earlier approved naturalistic illustrated full-body Adam character, use its realistic face proportions and illustrative finish. Draw ONE full-body Adam in blue jacket, white T shirt, navy shorts, blue sneakers, yellow backpack. Natural portrait-like likeness, basically a finely painted photograph of the actual boy, not a Disney/Pixar character. Keep original almond eyes size/shape and spacing, original long oval face, original eyebrows, nose, actual toothy smile, ears, original black wavy hair. Do not make eyes larger or rounder, cheeks inflated, chin smaller, or head ballooned. The boy is four years old height107cm. Head proportional as in image2, naturally childlike. Pose: compact upward platform jump, torso nearly upright, ONE fist clearly above head, other arm bent close to ribs, both knees gently flexed and feet close together directly below hips, soles nearly level, no separated legs. Body and head turned only modestly 25 degrees to screen right, eyes looking right toward destination, not at viewer; do not use a full profile that hides original face. Plain warm ivory backdrop, no scene, no text, no hat, no logo. Full figure generous margins above fist and below shoes. High resolution, realistic natural facial detail first priority.
production_base: Use case identity-preserve. Create production sprite sheet from IMAGE1 corrected natural Adam jump portrait. IMAGE2 original photo is authoritative face identity. Preserve the natural photographic/finely painted facial likeness from these two images, real almond eye size, actual child's face and smile, black wavy hair, natural head proportions. Do not cartoonify: NO Disney/Pixar/chibi/3D doll, no enlarged eyes/head. EXACT square 3 columns by 3 rows atlas (nine equal cells), high resolution. Same full-body scale/head size in each cell. Blue jacket white shirt navy shorts blue sneakers yellow backpack. Head/body turned subtly 25 degrees right like image1, gaze toward right/up on ascent and right/down on landing, not at camera. Full-body each cell, foot midpoints centered horizontally, sole baseline at90% cellheight each frame, ample padding above raised fists. Both feet stay close under hips in every pose, no straddle or split, no sideways lunge, no hat. EXACTLY nine distinct poses, uniform body scale, no text, no gridlines, NO SHADOWS, flat pure #FF00FF magenta background and no magenta lighting on skin. Most important EVERY face retains the photo's actual identity and natural anatomy, not a stylized animated movie face. Image1 supplies exact finish and facial rendering.
